method: Real PostgreSQL 17.11 resource transfers; independent restores, same pinned business inputs/clock, real SQL clock reads; three alternating-order repetitions per arm. Fresh process first commit and second consecutive commit. Three entities, no initial relation, one resource unit. Physical I/O is distinct from SQL statements and JSON codec bytes.
raw_archive_structure: Canonical filenames are relative paths within tar.gz; each JSON holds a complete unabridged stage-A meter record and all application source hashes.

measurement_disposition.clock_return: Both PostgreSQL clocks are queried by the original code. Only the returned business timestamp is pinned to make identical signed inputs reproducible.
measurement_disposition.pilot_excluded: Earlier harness skipped database clock round trips and was not admitted. All retained runs repeated with the final harness.
measurement_disposition.cpu_budget: Single CPU affinity 7 for probe including PostgreSQL; real concurrent background jobs share host resources. CPU 6 for generation, which does not contribute to probe latency.
measurement_disposition.latency_statistic: Median of 3 independently restored samples with A/B, B/A, A/B order. Raw samples retained. No tail quantiles or significance claim.
measurement_disposition.replay_measurement: Full reducer input counts only; a replay.hit is one additional event applied to a verified parent. SQL counts and decoded driver bytes are not physical blocks read.
